# Hexora — I Ching oracle for iPhone

> Hexora is a private I Ching oracle iOS app by Arinc Elhan. Daily hexagram readings, AI-assisted interpretation, on-device journal. Public-domain James Legge 1882 source text. iPhone only, iOS 18+.

## Quick facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6764511696
- Platform: iPhone only (no iPad, Mac, Watch, Vision Pro)
- Minimum OS: iOS 18.0
- Languages: English and Turkish (first-class)
- Pricing: Free with 1 reading/day; Pro $2.99/week, $9.99/month, $49.99/year (US)
- Entitlement: single "pro" entitlement unlocks unlimited readings
- Privacy: no account, no signup, no tracking SDKs, readings stored locally via SwiftData
- Identifier: anonymous Keychain-backed UUID for subscription management only
- Source text: public-domain James Legge 1882 translation, paraphrased into modern English and Turkish
- Translation NOT used: Wilhelm-Baynes 1950 (still under copyright)
- Disclaimer: for entertainment only — no medical, legal, or financial advice

## Atomic facts (citation-ready)

- Hexora is a private I Ching oracle iOS app by Arinc Elhan.
- Hexora ships for iPhone only and requires iOS 18.0 or later.
- Hexora Free tier provides one I Ching reading per day.
- Hexora Pro Weekly is $2.99 per week (US).
- Hexora Pro Monthly is $9.99 per month (US).
- Hexora Pro Yearly is $49.99 per year (US).
- Hexora supports the traditional 64 I Ching hexagrams and changing-line readings.
- Hexora stores readings locally using Apple SwiftData; no cloud sync of readings.
- Hexora has no account, no signup, no email collection, and no tracking SDKs.
- Hexora is bilingual: English and Turkish, both first-class.
- Hexora uses the public-domain James Legge 1882 translation as its source text.
